title: Design: New part with tracking off looks as in the design
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 1.6 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Inventory Part.
  2. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch.
  3. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The switch is blue with its knob at the right, and Min and Max show under it.

Step 2:

  • The switch turns grey with its knob at the left.
  • Min and Max are gone and Tags moves up, directly under the switch.
  • The "Inventory" heading and the bin row, with its Quantity box and "Default" tag, still show.

Step 3:

  • The window closes and no part is created.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10817 (Story 4, Create an Untracked Part)

  • S4-R5: “When the switch is off, Min and Max are hidden.”
  • S4-R6: “When the switch is off, the bin location section stays visible and is optional. A bin can be set as a shelf reference without being required to save.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: board "1.6 Branch: a new part with tracking off". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above where the PRD speaks, and from the board pictures where it is silent about the look.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • create-06-p1-6-untracked.png

The design's own words:

  • “With the switch off, Min and Max are hidden (S4-R5). The bin location section stays visible and is optional, so a bin can be set as a shelf reference (S4-R6). Creating a part with tracking off needs the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission (S8-R7). Editing other fields of a part that is already untracked needs the same access as editing a tracked part (S8-N1a).”
